baseline.fixtureIdentityPolicy: Fixture text, Grain document IDs, and Grain allocation IDs are derived from this seed. Yjs client IDs are generated by Yjs and are reported as observed values.

historicalResults.label: historical, not a current result
historicalResults.source: PR #43 report as cited by the authoritative grain/52 proposal
historicalResults.limits: Separate medians are not an end-to-end median. The heap figure does not isolate listener cost.

measurementRules.percentiles: Nearest-rank p50 and p95 over measured operations. Each process reports mean and population standard deviation. The runner reports median and median absolute deviation across fresh-process p50 values, plus p95 of those process p50 values.
measurementRules.freshProcesses: Each run starts a new npm/Vitest process. Do not run profiles concurrently on a shared performance worker.
measurementRules.memory: Report heap and RSS separately. Forced-GC availability and whether samples were collected after GC are included in output.
measurementRules.bytes: Native transaction update bytes, accepted action envelope bytes, complete delete-set range counts, and encoded checkpoint bytes are distinct measurements.
measurementRules.hardware: Timing results are observations for the recorded environment, not budgets or portable performance claims.
